wiki.title: Drone Fauzz
wiki.text:
Drone Fauzz is a bixie NPC boss that can be found in the Bixie Hive, located in Sanctuary. He is a bixie drone who trying to take over the hive, and it is up to the player to come for help Bixie Queen regain control by defeating Drone Fauzz.
Category:NPC
Category:Enemies
Category:Boss
Category:Males
Category:Bixie
Category:Sanctuary
